correctness.rationale: Integrating (log x)'=1-x-y over one positive period yields meanx+meany=1. Periodicity of the delayed product yields mean(x y)=s exp(sτ) meany/Y=x_* meany. Integrating xdot=x-x²-xy gives E[x²]=(1+x_*)meanx-x_*. Thus Varx=(meanx-x_*)(1-meanx)=meany(1-x_*-meany) and Cov(x,y)=-(Varx). If x(t) constant then prey equation forces y(t) constant, so nonconstant cycle has Varx>0 and x_*<meanx<1 (hence x_*<1). Cauchy–Schwarz yields Vary≥Varx, equality forcing y-mean y=-(x-mean x), so x+y identically 1 and xdot=0, impossible for nonconstant cycle. Exact source parameters give exp(81/50)/30≈0.16843634388546225. All statements are integral identities, no trajectory sampling as proof.
